component.name: FoxRes
component.summary: Resistor color codes, SMD markings and standard values

description.p: FoxRes is a fast, accurate resistor calculator for electronics work.

ul.li: Decode 3, 4, 5 and 6-band color codes, or type a value to get its bands
Read and generate SMD markings: 3-digit, 4-digit, R notation and EIA-96
Find the nearest E3 to E192 standard value, with the error shown
Find the best series or parallel pair of standard values for any target

description.p: First release: color bands, SMD codes, E-series and two-resistor combinations.
